roleTitle: Staff Development Coordinator & Infection Control Nurse (RN)
description: Join a premier skilled nursing facility in Oakland, MD, as a Staff Development Coordinator & Infection Control Nurse. This vital full-time role combines expertise in staff education and competency with robust infection prevention and control strategies. You will play a key part in ensuring our team is well-trained and our environment is safe for both residents and staff. We are seeking a dedicated professional to uphold the highest standards of care and compliance. This full-time opportunity offers competitive hourly compensation.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in Maryland
Experience in staff development or infection control within a healthcare setting
Knowledge of state and federal regulations related to nursing and infection prevention
salaryOrBonusInfo: Compensation is $40.00 - $42.00 per hour, based on experience.
